macros.name: block
macros.doc: Blocks are created with the command \block[options]{title}{text}.

macros.name: block
macros.doc: Blocks are created with the command \block[options]{title}{text}.

macros.name: coloredbox
macros.doc: Colored boxes can be used for emphasizing parts of the block body and are generated by \coloredbox[options]{Text}.

macros.name: coloredbox
macros.doc: Colored boxes can be used for emphasizing parts of the block body and are generated by \coloredbox[options]{Text}.

macros.name: column
macros.doc: To begin a column, use the command \column{width}, e.g., width=0.3\textwidth or width=20cm.

macros.name: colwidth
macros.doc: The width of the column may be referred – for formatting pictures or altering a block’s width, for instance – by referencing the length \colwidth.

macros.name: definecolorpalette
macros.doc: The palette is defined by the command \definecolorpalette{color palette name}{definitions}.

macros.name: defineinnerblockstyle
macros.doc: If the user wants, additional inner block styles may be created with the command \defineinnerblockstyle{stylename} {default values}{commands}.

macros.name: innerblock
macros.doc: Inner blocks, called by the command \innerblock[options]{Heading}{Text}, are blocks placed in the body.

macros.name: innerblock
macros.doc: Inner blocks, called by the command \innerblock[options]{Heading}{Text}, are blocks placed in the body.

macros.name: settitle
macros.doc: One can redefine the way the title matter (title, author, etc.) are arranged by calling \settitle.

macros.name: tikzposterlatexaffectionproofoff
macros.doc: To turn off the comment on how the poster was created in the lower right corner, include in the preamble \tikzposterlatexaffectionproofoff.

macros.name: useblockstyle
macros.doc: If the user wishes to use blocks with a different style, he or she may use \useblockstyle[options]{style name}.

macros.name: useblockstyle
macros.doc: If the user wishes to use blocks with a different style, he or she may use \useblockstyle[options]{style name}.

macros.name: useinnerblockstyle
macros.doc: If one wishes, inner blocks may have their appearance changed by the command \useinnerblockstyle{style name}.

macros.name: useinnerblockstyle
macros.doc: If one wishes, inner blocks may have their appearance changed by the command \useinnerblockstyle{style name}.

macros.name: usenotestyle
macros.doc: If the user wants to use one of the included note styles Default, Corner, VerticalShading, or Sticky, then the command \usenotestyle[options]{style name} may be employed.

macros.name: usenotestyle
macros.doc: If the user wants to use one of the included note styles Default, Corner, VerticalShading, or Sticky, then the command \usenotestyle[options]{style name} may be employed.

macros.name: usetheme
macros.doc: A theme is called by the command \usetheme{layout style} where the argument is either a predefined object name in tikzposterLayoutthemes.tex, or a style defined in the preamble for the appropriate object.

macros.name: usetitlestyle
macros.doc: If the default simple box surrounding the title matter is not desired, the user may use one of the several predefined title styles by using in the preamble \usetitlestyle[options]{style name} where the argument is a style listed in tikzposterTitlestyles.tex or the name of a style defined in the preamble.

macros.name: usetitlestyle
macros.doc: If the default simple box surrounding the title matter is not desired, the user may use one of the several predefined title styles by using in the preamble \usetitlestyle[options]{style name} where the argument is a style listed in tikzposterTitlestyles.tex or the name of a style defined in the preamble.

envs.name: columns
envs.doc: If multicolumn formats are desired, the environment columns may be used.

envs.name: subcolumns
envs.doc: If you wish to create a set of subcolumns in the current column, the environment subcolumns can be used.
